integrity: Analytical exact proof and independent finite numerical checks; publication priority and independent scientific audit have not been certified.
scientific_limitations: Equilibrium-stationary full-reset Brownian renewal process; strictly positive iid intervals, finite second moment; smooth-lag exact covariance required for inverse; heavy-tail asymptotics add regular variation. No noisy-data inversion theorem or general nonrenewal result.
title: The covariance fingerprint and sharp clock ordering for stationary renewal-reset Brownian motion
